title: Versioned evaluation profile
$comment: PROFILE-001 defines the closed per-field resolution. requirementMapping is a complete leaf declaration, never a delta: it has one neutral route per canonical requirement and every route is recomputed against a closed requirement-implementation-contract-1 by the distribution-owned resolver. It contains no claimant-declared preservation, strengthening, applicability, or conformance result. Other keyed collections are deltas unless PROFILE-001 names a complete declaration. Set values use closed-enum order and keyed collections use lexical key order.

parentProfile.$comment: Resolve and authenticate at most one parent; semantic flattening sets this field to null in the effective projection.

baseCompatibility.$comment: Every profile in a chain must bind the same standard version, verdict, and requirement-registry identity, version, and digest. A document-relative URI may differ only when it resolves to that same artifact.

signatureProfile.$comment: The leaf's explicit algorithm, key-authorization, revocation, time, and anti-rollback binding for signed evaluation artifacts. This field is never inherited: every child declares it, the child profile's own signature.profileId equals it, and the effective projection takes the leaf value. Each source profile in an inheritance chain is authenticated under its own binding before resolution. deployment_bound additionally requires typed, authenticated external key-authorization, revocation, trusted-time, and anti-rollback contracts; rejects fixture or repository-reference signature trust; and authorizes the signing key for this artifact schema, owner role, and every declared assurance-by-risk tuple.

claimTrustProfile.$comment: The leaf's explicit, separately governed operational trust binding for claim and governance acceptance. This field is never inherited from parent evaluation profiles: every child must declare it, and the effective projection takes the leaf value. Semantic validation authenticates its authorization, revocation, trusted-time, and anti-rollback contracts and checks coverage for this profile's assurance and risk range.

claimTrustUse.$comment: The leaf's explicit trust-use classification; it is never inherited. conformance_fixture_requires_external_rekey makes fixture trust non-deployable. deployment_bound is valid only with externally provisioned, owner-verified trust and never with repository reference keys.

supportedAssuranceLevels.$comment: The child array is a complete replacement and must be a nonempty subset of the parent set; it is not unioned.

effectiveRiskRange.$comment: The child array is a complete replacement and is a nonempty subset of the parent set; it is not unioned. This range is only a profile eligibility boundary. The actual case, experiment, and decision tiers come from authenticated risk-assessment-1 records and are not inferred from this range.

capabilityFamilies.$comment: The child array is a complete replacement and must be a nonempty subset of the parent set; it is not unioned.

interactionModes.$comment: The child array is a complete replacement of closed concrete IDs and must be a nonempty subset of the parent set; omitted parent modes are removed rather than inherited.

workArtifactRegistry.$comment: The sole authenticated work-artifact-type to capability-family mapping. Every profile in a chain must preserve the same authenticated id, version, and digest; a document-relative URI may differ only when it resolves to that exact artifact.

allowedOutcomeProfiles.$comment: The child array is a complete declaration and must resolve to a nonempty subset of authenticated parent IDs. Omitted parent IDs are removed from the effective declaration, new IDs are forbidden, and a retained ID whose pointer differs from the parent's effective pointer requires the PROFILE-001 content_equal, preserves, or strengthens replacement proof.

caseContract.$comment: The versioned profile-specific case-shape contract. Every profile in a chain must preserve the same authenticated id, version, and digest; a document-relative URI may differ only when it resolves to that exact artifact.

gateRegistry.$comment: A child singleton replaces its parent only after resolving both registries and proving preservation or strengthening of every applicable parent gate.

caseQa.$comment: A child singleton replaces its parent only after resolving both contracts and proving preservation or strengthening of every applicable parent QA obligation.

metrics.$comment: Merge by id; omission is not deletion.

failureTaxonomy.$comment: A child singleton replaces its parent only after resolving both taxonomies and proving that no applicable cause, attribution, or fail-closed outcome is weakened or lost.

additionalAssuranceRequirements.$comment: The base standard owns A1-A3 semantics. These entries are additive deltas only; semantic validation must union them with the base level and all lower levels and must reject deletion, replacement, downgrade, or reinterpretation of a base assurance requirement.

fixtures.$comment: Semantic validation must authenticate a distribution-registered manifest and distribution-owned executor, resolve manifestExpectationId exactly once, execute that expectation under its declared schema and semantic checks, and require the observed result to match both manifest valid and expectedVerdict. A negative must fail for manifest expectedError. Descriptor-supplied validators or reports and execution cycles are invalid.

requirementMapping.$comment: A complete lexically ordered leaf routing table. Each entry names the leaf as source and points to its authenticated requirement-implementation-contract-1. Semantic validation checks exact canonical-registry coverage and recomputes every contract entry; the mapping expresses no conformance relation or applicability decision.

conflictReport.$comment: The evidence pointer may equal resolutionEvidence when the signed profile-resolution record also establishes no unresolved conflicts.

resolutionEvidence.$comment: Required detached derived record. It must resolve and validate against profile-resolution-record-1, bind this exact profile ID and version, reproduce effectiveProfileDigest, and remain outside the effective-profile digest projection.
